images.caption: Figure 1:Skill benefit tracks base capability.(a)On103103skill-sensitive pairs, injected skills boost strong- and mid-tier models by+27+27pt on average, yet leave the weak tier nearly unchanged at+1+1pt.(b)The gap is not missing guidance: given the same skill, the strong model follows its instructions and passes, while the weak model ignores them and fails.
Figure 2:Skill adaptation in self-evolution.Over five rounds, weak executors improve steadily with skill adaptation but barely move without it. Horizontal lines: tier averages.

Figure 4:Overview of our approach.Left:the meta-skill is constructed by attributing weak-model failures across tasks from three benchmarks to four failure modes.Right:the meta-skill guides a self-evolving loop of skill execution and rewriting, either in one shot by a strong model or iteratively by a weak model from its own execution evidence.
